_comment: Process files in `order` with one shared dedupe set, then the OpenCode database, then the Antigravity databases in `antigravity.order` (same dedupe set). Paths are relative to this folder. `mtimes` (Unix ms) give the modification times that produce both orders; apply them to a copy of this folder before computing daily history. `traces` (Gemini, omp) give the phase after feeding a file up to and including physical line `afterLine` (after the files before it in `order`). omp: the folder `omp` plays ~/.omp, so its automatic roots are omp/agent/sessions and omp/profiles/*/agent/sessions; `omp.discover` lists what discovery finds there. Antigravity: the folder `antigravity` plays ~/.gemini (stores antigravity-cli, antigravity, antigravity-ide); each database is one agent whose id is its path; `{"unsupported": true}` marks a database that contributes no agent; reading must not create any file (no -wal or -shm).
